text: Human beings developed from earlier species of animals.

room.label: U.S. adults
room.questionWording: Human beings, as we know them today, developed from earlier species of animals.
room.note: 2012 survey; older data. 48% answered correctly (true). NSF reports the share answering correctly; don’t-know is counted on the wrong side.

truthSource.label: National Academies of Sciences, Evolution resources
truthSource.oneLine: Fossil, genetic and anatomical evidence establishes that humans evolved from earlier species.

lesson.tip: Answers can reflect who people are as much as what they know. Separate what you believe from what the evidence shows.
